pictures.name: ZGO1-Courtyard
pictures.prompt: Ancient China around 500 BCE, a teacher’s courtyard with a gnarled old apricot tree in blossom and grey roof tiles. Confucius, a tall dignified teacher of about seventy with a long grey beard and grey hair tied in a topknot, in layered dark blue and brown silk robes with wide sleeves, sits on a low mat teaching a small circle of students in plain robes. Among them, leaning forward eagerly, Zigong, a sharp, well-dressed man in his thirties with a short black beard and hair in a topknot, in fine russet and gold silk robes with a jade pendant at his belt. Soft morning gold light, blue shadows under the eaves. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
